products.name: Workday AI
products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California, listed on the stock exchange under the ticker WDAY. It offers cloud-based software for human resources, finance, and IT, and its most recent annual filing reported revenue of approximately $9.552 billion for the period ending January 31, 2026.

The company describes its platform as an enterprise AI system built around HR, finance, and IT workflows. Its primary AI product, Workday AI, is presented on the company's site as enabling teams of specialized agents to find, build, act, and automate across those domains, with the company framing this capability around trust, agility, and data readiness. The site also references a product or integration called Sana in connection with its agentic AI offering.

The held facts record nine federal civil cases filed against Workday across multiple jurisdictions, including the Eastern District of California, the Northern District of Georgia, the Northern District of California, the District of Colorado, the District of Maryland, and the Eastern District of Virginia, with case names involving plaintiffs Meckfessel Poletti, Williams, Elias, Noriega, Hill, and Doe. The tracked product note flags potential sensitive HR data exposure as a point of relevance to the Workday AI offering.
